what_it_does: This work addresses scalability challenges when running Conjugate Gradient solvers (an iterative linear algebra algorithm) across large clusters of GPUs. The paper explores different communication strategies where either the CPU or GPU can initiate data movement between computing nodes, combined with hardware-aware message-passing libraries and GPU-native collective communication (NCCL/RCCL). The focus is on reducing communication bottlenecks that prevent these algorithms from scaling efficiently across thousands of GPUs.
